title: Sayyidina Muhammad (s) Never Came Back From Isra and Mi`raj (The
body:
Night Journey)

(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Laa ilaaha illa-Llah, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Muhammadan
Rasoolullah, `alayhi salaatullah was salaamuh. A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'rRahmani 'r-Raheem. Thumma as-salaat wa 's-salaam `ala jami` al-anbiya wa 'l-mursaleen w 'alhamdulillah
Rabbi 'l-`Alameen. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Thumma as-salaam `ala Saahib az-Zamaan, Sayyidina Mahdi (a). Thumma as-salaam `ala Qutb alMutasarrif; our heavenly salute on our protector on this planet, Qutb al-Mutasarrif, and for all awliya, saints,
who act.
It is a humble meeting, but we are addressing all people, through east and west from north to south, on this
planet.
O our Attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum. SubhaanAllahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Azheem. SubhaanAllahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l`Azheem. Among our attenders, there is a group of people saying, We are Salafi `ulamas," and you know who
you are. They claim this for themselves, a title they give to themselves; a group of people from some countries
are saying that. And now (the awliya) are making me address people, and I am knowing nothing. If they are
not supporting something, it is difficult to address even to a billion people, it doesn't matter. If heavenly

support reaches, even an ant may address not billions but a trillion people! Yes, not billions but trillions, it is
easy to address them; (if Allah likes) even an ant may address all people! Asta`eedhu billah. ••••••• ••••••••
Qaalat namlatun, "One ant spoke." (27:18) The meaning? This is mukhaatab, ayyuha 'l-naml. That means, if
Allah Almighty asks any creature to address them, it is enough to make an ant call them and make them hear
(that message).
Wali, a saint; who is a saint? A saint may hear. He may take an ant in his hand, making like this, (Mawlana
Shaykh puts his hand to his ear) and that waliyullah can hear the ant's speech as thunder! Therefore, the holy
ones are looking after shu'oon ad-dunya, everything that is happening, as nothing happens by itself. There is
a heavenly will, iraadah. There is no partner for the Lord's Will and no one knows His Will. If the Lord of
Heavens yureed, asks to make His servants to hear from east to west and from north to south, I am too weak,
but if He orders even an ant, that ant can la yuhazz ad-dunya, shake the world! Everything would be shaking
and trembling, if an ant may say only, "O my Lord!" Yuhazz ad-dunya iradah, leave (discussion of) that
Divine Will; if you are coming on the lowest level, that power is granted to Allah Almighty's chosen ones! If
He is saying, (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar! Everything must stand up, like the Night of Power,
Laylat al-Qadr. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Yes, now we are talking about this planet, that scientists say is a globe
and that the sun and the moon are something else. People are saying that our world is moving, and that the
sun is stable, not moving, and what we are looking at is the sun moving, and our Earth is thaabit, fixed
(stationary).
There is one ayatul-kareemah; Allah Almighty is saying, one, two or three verses full of haqaa`iq, realities.
Asta`eedhu billah: (Mawlana Shaykh stands)

wa maa qataloohu wa maa salaboohu wa laakin shubbiha lahum wa inna 'Lladheena 'khtalafoo feehi lafee
shakkin minhu maa lahum bihi min `ilmin 'illaa attibaa`a azh-zhanni wa maa qataloohu yaqeena. But they
killed him (Jesus) not, nor crucified him, but the resemblance of `Isa (Jesus) was put over another man
(whom they killed), and those who differ therein are full of doubts. They have no certain knowledge; they
follow nothing but conjecture, for surely they killed him not. (An-Nisa, 4:157)

(Mawlana Shaykh sits). There are so many things `ulamas may take from that ayatul-kareemah! Jesus Christ
is living that tashbeeh, similar appearance. Those holy verses contain Secret Meaning Oceans, secrets of
wisdoms, and secrets of unlimited Unseen worlds. For people it is tashbeeh, the appearance of the sun rising,
the sun setting, and dunya is stable. But scientists say, "No, the sun is rising and walking and setting." That is
tashbeeh, "to be seen." As they are looking in such a way at everything in this Creation, from this side you
may see a new appearance and from that side another appearance. If I am looking at you, your appearance
will be in such a way, and if I am looking from the side or from the back, it is going to be different.
Awliyaullah, saints, who have secret knowledge, are saying about the Divine Appearances, that for each one
there are 24,000 new appearances coming daily! Allahu Akbar! (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar alAkbar! Allahu Akbar al-Akbar! (Mawlana Shaykh sits). You think that there are fixed forms? Never! Even
when we are standing, our fixed appearance is something else and when we are sitting our appearance is
another. Even if we are standing a hundred times, we are changing (in appearance). (Mawlana Shaykh
stands) Allahu Akbar al-Akbar! Allahu Akbar al-Akbar! Subhaan Sen! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
We are sitting here, and the Lord of Heavens is asking to open new horizons for believers and for ahlu 'lfahem, "scientists." Allah, Allah. Those clouds in every second are in another appearance. Allahu Akbar!
Allahu Akbar! Therefore, ma`rifatullah, heavenly knowledge, is something else, and Divinely Appearance is
another thing. The last limit of all Creation is up to the divinely level, not beyond! Therefore, it is mentioned
the Seal of Prophets, sayyidi 'r-rusulu 'l-kiraam (s) was invited on the Night Journey? I am asking our Salafi
`ulamas, kam Isra'a, how many Night Journeys happened? Only once? What happened? Was Allah Almighty
inviting only once? Do you think that a King invites the honorable members of His Kingdom only once, no
second time? Even if a sultan is weak, he will not invite only once, but several times, or you may say countless
times! Then how can it happen that the Lord of Heavens invites His most beloved one only once and not
more? Allah Almighty is "Maalik al-Mulk"!
I am always asking the Salafi `ulamas what do you think about the Mir`aj, "Night Journey"? Who invited the
Seal of Prophets (s)? His Lord invited him. Did His Lord invite him or was anyone else sending the invitation
min qabal aw min ba`d? Did such an invitation happen before, or will it happen after that? They know
nothing, as their level of understanding is so low! They are not saying that Allah Almighty's invitation, Qur'an
al-Kareem kalaamullahi 'l-azali. Azali is from pre-Eternal to Eternal. How many times (did He invite), and for

whom did that invitation happen? That invitation came only for Prophet (s)! What do you think about that
invitation? Do you think it expired? Laa shareeka lahu wa laa shabeehan lah Allah subhanahu wa ta`ala (He
has no partner and He has none to be compared with Allah the Glorified and Exalted)! If Allah (swt) invited
His most beloved one and is showing what is able to be seen by His most beloved one, do you think that He
sent him back down (to Earth)? What is your opinion? Is the Lord of Heavens calling and giving such an
invitation and afterwards saying, "Go away."
Yes, He sent one with his name as a representative for His servants. But the real being (essence) of
Rasoolullah (s) had never been sent to people, no. That invitation was to take him to Allah Almighty's Divine
Presence and keep him there with Allah, Who sent one representative on behalf of His most beloved one;
what we were seeing and hearing was only one representative. How many representatives are there?
Countless! The real being is with Allah Almighty and there are countless representatives of that real being!
O Salafi `ulamas! Marhaban! How are you? Are you not accepting this? He is Allah! He is Able to do
anything! When never takes back what He grants! He invited mataa (when)? Fee yawm al-azal, the Day of
Azal, "Eternity" for the Lord of Heavens. He called him from azal, His most beloved one was invited from
Eternity, and laa yazaal, he is with his Lord, Allah Almighty. May Allah give us some understanding. Wa
laakin shubiha lahum, there is tashbeeh here; He sent one surah, appearance, because this world cannot
carry more than that or it would melt and nothing would remain. Subhaanahu wa ta`ala! Where is Masjid alAqsa?
••••••••• ••••••• ••••••• •••••••••• ••••••• ••••• ••••••••••• •••••••••• ••••• ••••••••••• •••••••••
Subhaana 'Lladhee asrá bi `abdihi laylan mina 'l-Masjidi 'l-Haraami ila 'l-Masjidi al-Aqsá. Exalted be He
Who took His servant for a journey by night from al-Masjid al-Haraam (at Mecca) to the Farthest Mosque (in
Jerusalem). (al-'Israa, 17:1)
The meanings are like oceans, impossible to understand! Every time a new opening comes, giving
refreshment and pleasure and enlightenment to the real beings of Mankind. Our real being is not on this
planet; it is where we were, in the Divine Presence on the Day of Promises. Did that event close down, or is it
continued? Continued, yes.

They have not made me speak of such a thing before, but his (a guest's) understanding is making me speak
about such things. Some ones may ask, "Why the shaykh is speaking this way?"
Hasan al-Basri, Allah bless him, was advising people time by time, and Sayyida Rabi`a al-`Adawiyya was
living then, may Allah bless them both. One day he was speaking, addressing and making some openings for
haadiri, "presence people," and people said, "O Imam! Today there are so many simple things you are saying,
and we are accustomed to hearing something new." And what was the answer from Hasan al-Basri? "Do you
think I prepare to give to ants what I prepared to be given to elephants? Today, elephants are not here;
therefore, I am giving this, saying it is enough and good for you!" What was his aim? It was that Rabi`a al`Adawiyya was not there, so Heavens reserved a big heavenly grant. "Saahibatah is not here; therefore, I
cannot give you more (knowledge) as you are such small ones that can be crushed. So I am giving you a small
one." Therefore, today heavenly ones sent something on the lowest, for Sumoo al-Ameer's (His Majesty
Prince's) honor and Sayyid's (Habeeb `Ali al-Jafri) honor.
May Allah forgive us in this holy month! May Allah grant us a good understanding, according to our levels,
not more. And we are asking for the honor of this holy month to give us divine blessings, to make us always
asking for divinely grants, for the honor of the Seal of Prophets (s), and his followers, and for the honor of all
prophets, peace be upon them. May Allah forgive us.
Fatihah.

(Mawlana Shaykh speaks with Shaykh Hisham Effendi on the phone.)
Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar!
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two raka`at Salaat ash-Shukr.)
